rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -E '\b(honest|delve|landscape|importantly|crucial|substrate|leverage|synergize|paradigm shift)\b' lines 1-79 → zero hits in body

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Ritual / ceremony — hard ban in any curriculum/training surface.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -E '\b(ritual|ceremony)\b' lines 1-79 → zero hits in body. Term 'practice' not used in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No dated session markers, no 'NOTE: outdated', no 'retained as historical', no 'Caught live', no 'Moved out' in body. Historical dates exist in maintainer block only (proper location).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Register match.
rules_evaluated.evidence: AE101 voice contract honored: factual+direct (Boris: 'The rules are already in the session'), strategic reframe (Rory: 'The scrollback is the right source here'), warm peer tone (Godin-natural throughout). Register stable across body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule 5 applies to article drafts; this is a curriculum exercise, not an article rough-cut.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No named practitioner techniques paraphrased without attribution. Framework references in backing block only (proper location). no body hits on technique names.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Second person 'you' used consistently: 'you just ran', 'you react', 'you brought', 'you pick', 'you decide'. No 'the student', no 'say it plainly', no trainer-POV delivery mechanics in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No maintainer-only terms found in body prose. 'Scrollback' is M1-earned (referenced in M1's 'the-machine-you-just-met' principle); 'compounding' used but earned by M2 curriculum; 'task-shaping rule' earned in this exercise's own context.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No reassurance-shaped sentences. No 'it's OK if', 'no penalty', 'you are not on the hook for' constructions. Prose holds structure without apology.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule 10 applies to reference artifacts with 'Frame to land' sections; this is an exercise, not a reference artefact.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No named practitioners cited in body (Klaassen, Pocock, Martin, etc. appear in backing block only). Framework names in backing cite + sources; body clean.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Framing 'find a place for your rules' is sharp. Table + notes structure (rows 52-64) provides carve-out naming mechanisms + constraints. No softening of original punch.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No defensive framing ('not aspirational', 'not vendor', 'real practitioners', 'unlike consultancy'). Body teaches procedure, not position. Boundary surfaces clean (no trainer-POV table annotations).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Terms like 'scrollback' (M1-earned context), 'story ticket' (locally defined), 'tracker' (contextually clear), 'CLAUDE.md' (M1 introduced). LLM vocabulary absent. No premature technical depth.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closers use declarative claims with clear action: 'The file sits unread' (consequence), 'The choice is yours' (agency). No dangling pronouns, no vague referents. Diagnostic passes.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The **What happened:** block is OPTIONAL.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'What happened:' block in this exercise file (correctly omitted per rule 16 default). Ends on last real move (Phase 3 automation-shapes read).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Verbs describing agent interaction: 'reads', 'proposes', 'writes', 'names', 'infer'. No 'command', 'bark', 'order', 'drag', 'boss'. Peer-flat tone held.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Headers literal: 'Phase 1: Codify', 'Reject or rewrite', 'Read more rules', 'Phase 2: Save', 'Where rules can live', 'Phase 3: What this file could automate', 'Read the shapes'. No spatial metaphors mismatched to mechanism.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Machine-cadence fat — the shape of good prose without the content.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No empty negation, no deictic drumroll ('That is the X'), no bold-label echo, no citation duplication. Table row language directly operational, not restating structure.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No statements like 'three things below' adjacent to lists. Table introduces 'Where rules can live' without prefacing count. Numerals used only where they carry forward (not restating structure).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing — run the truth test before reaching for §12.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No superlative claims ('only', 'always', 'never', 'nothing else'). Scope on exercise-specific work ('the rules are already in the session' = true for this session). No false universals.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A claim binds to every body that states it, not just the one holding the stamp.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No sourced claims requiring re-verification across files. Exercise is standalone; backing block sources are M2-module-local and carry their own stamps.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Aspirational frame held: 'find a place for your rules', 'capture-and-name', 'the rule sits in MY file at MY location' (from maintainer). No corrective tone ('you're missing', 'you already think').

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Terms earned contextually: 'scrollback' (M1-established), 'story ticket' (defined as 'one story from your tracker'), 'tracker' (contextual use), 'rules' (defined by exercise). No jargon dumps.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No unearned tech words. SVP marketing test: 'scrollback', 'rules', 'story ticket' are operational, not corporate-speak. No jargon-ban hits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No conflation. 'Rules file' (memory artifact), 'scrollback' (session context), 'story rules' (persistent learnings). Vocabulary precise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body — THIS RULE HAS AN EXCEPTION; read to the boundary before cutting anything.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No troubleshooting branches in body. Fallback 'No tracker this session can reach? Paste the fields instead' appears in phase-gate prompt, not body. Golden path held in prose.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule 6 addresses prompt-authoring guidance; this is exercise body, not a prompt under review.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module. Compound-shape varies per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'review → rewrite → report' or 'save-if-earned' or standard retro shapes. Compound shape in this module is 'save + decide location + name automation shapes' (different from M1's rule-extraction compound). Variety held.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
rules_evaluated.evidence: M2 exercise voice consistent with module mood (grounded-competence extending into capture). No M1 joyful-creation, no M5 long-running mood. Voice disciplined.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'check Claude's work', 'spot errors', 'review for accuracy'. Instruction sentences name actor+mechanism: 'Claude reads → proposes rules', 'Claude opens ticket → reverses-engineers fields'. Student asks, agent does.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No simulation personas invoked (Teacher Claude, Builder Claude). Exercise body is procedural, not simulation-shaped.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No "What research says" callout boxes.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No callout boxes in body. Citation of frameworks in backing block only (proper location). Body stays practitioner-voiced.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student moves stay in conversation with agent.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Prompts direct Claude to read, propose, reverse-engineer, and decide. No manual editor/terminal/file-edit forcing functions in body. Student stays in chat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Table rows at lines 55-60 specify layers: './CLAUDE.md', './CLAUDE.local.md', '~/.claude/CLAUDE.md'. No bare 'CLAUDE.md'. Distinction held.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No em-dashes in body (auto-fixed by hook, per check_writing.md §1). Sentences short and direct. Parentheses used only for clarification (role, origin).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing something.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Headers with command verbs: 'Codify the rules', 'Reject or rewrite', 'Read more rules', 'Save the file', 'Read the shapes'. All exercise sections use action verbs.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.
rules_evaluated.evidence: One link at line 64: '[Claude Code for engineers](../trainings/agentic-engineering-101/reference/claude-code-for-engineers.md)' uses title 'Claude Code for engineers', not filename. Proper link text.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Disambiguate shared-word collisions with Claude Code primitives on first student-authored use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Terms 'memory' (M1-earned as student-authored memory vs auto-memory), 'skill' (context makes team-kit skill clear), 'rule' (context-disambiguated from Claude Code rules). First use tied to student action.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Agent used for acting: 'the agent reads scrollback, writes rules, reverses-engineers'. Claude used for addressee: 'Ask Claude for rules', 'ask Claude to contrast'. LLM avoided. Vocabulary sharp.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'tomorrow', 'overnight', 'this morning', 'tonight', 'next morning'. Module-relative phrasing used ('at M5', 'when you come back'). Time-of-day clean.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No pedagogical headers: 'Pause before', 'Meta-moment', 'The reflection beat', 'Step back'. No contemplative-pause prefixes ('sit with', 'let it land', 'take a moment'). Beat structure transparent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No meta-ask when student has already decided.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'Ask me which one' meta-loops after student has decided. Prompts direct action; student decides before next loop. No paper-step between decision and action.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: `.md` is default file type for student artifacts across curriculum.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Prompts direct to 'rules file' (.md implied, not specified because format is default). No `.txt`, no `.docx`. Implicit default honored.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No implementation details before point-of-use. Table rows (where rules live) do work: student picks location, understands loading model, wires if needed. No obvious-to-engineers padding.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body "read it" / "look at it" / "notice X" after chat-print = dead weight.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'Read the table', 'Look at the list', 'Notice the row'. Table stands; body moves to next action ('Decide the location'). Prose doesn't narrate student's read.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Forward-callout closers pass subject test: 'You ask Claude to recover', 'you make the location decision', 'you can move it later'. Student as agent of future action throughout.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only where introduced.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Operational state (CLAUDE.md layers) re-stated at Phase 2 where student picks location. Prework default mentioned; per-phase reminder present. Affordance honored.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Echo the training's theory spine before inventing a synonym.
rules_evaluated.evidence: House vocabulary used: 'rules', 'compounding', 'capture', 'automation shapes', 'loading mechanisms'. No invented synonyms for training terms.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the artifact, not the act.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Prompts referenced as nouns: 'a "continue"-prompt', 'the prompt'. No 'typing', 'saying', 'telling Claude'. Utterance treated as artifact.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the outcome; don't walk a professional through trivial mechanics.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No recipe-walk for 'paste the fields' or 'open the tracker'. Outcomes stated: 'the location is reversible', 'the file lands where you pick'. Mechanics delegated to Claude.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The curriculum does not narrate itself — subject test, then deletion test.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No arc-positioning sentences. Subject test on every prose line: artifacts/tasks/decisions (keep) vs module/training/exercise (cut). All kept lines are student-work-focused.
